ai_briefing.morning_summary: Major coins slipped 3-8% on Delta India, with Bitcoin down 2.58% and Ethereum down 4.97%, as negative sentiment from the upcoming flash-crash anniversary and uptober pull-back persists. DeFi activity on Solana consolidates after the Orca-Loopscale merger, while regulatory headlines—US Bitcoin seizure, IMF risk warning, and NFL pushback on prediction markets—add pressure.
